svg.title: Repository layout
svg.desc: Root ai-engineering-harness/. README.md: the pack's own guide. VERSION: the version number. PACK_MANIFEST.json: release identity and state. CHANGELOG.md: what changed, per release. DECISIONS.md: recorded design decisions. skills/core/: 14 procedural skills. policy/: routing, budgets, approval. templates/: files a project copies. tools/: checks and project tools. tools/tests/: the test suite. docs/: gate records and designs. .github/: this page, images, notes.
